description: A utility class for working with MIME types in Drupal, providing methods to get icon classes and generic MIME types based on file MIME types.
external_files: none (internal PHP functions and language features)

classes.name: IconMimeTypes
classes.description: A final utility class for determining icon classes and generic MIME types based on MIME types.

methods.name: getIconClass
methods.description: Returns an icon class for a given MIME type, based on generic MIME type or category.

methods.name: getGenericMimeType
methods.description: Determines the generic MIME package for a specific MIME type, returning a string or false.
